permission_controls.causality: Latest injected effect is CONFIRMED solely to isolate the final pending-permission predicate from effectsReconciled. This is an INJECTED residual-state guard control, NOT proof that a real permission lifecycle produced this state. The original Run/current Task/queue remain settled. Save all injection row diffs; never label it real tool execution.
permission_controls.state_variants: OPEN comes from createResourceRequest. ACKNOWLEDGED and RESOLVED are explicit test-only schema-valid next versions via existing put/bump semantics on the new synthetic request, not UPDATE original rows, and not real user permission actions. RESOLVED includes resolved_by original authorized principal; any required resolution evidence is explicitly synthetic. Refuse to fabricate a historic permission decision or original runtime provenance.
permission_controls.expected: OPEN/ACKNOWLEDGED must reach exact typed SESSION_BUSY with message session permission remains unresolved; positive same linkage and effect state with RESOLVED must COMPLETED. Earlier lease/CAS/Task/queue refusal is prerequisite failure, not target success.

nonhead_run_controls.injection: Retain actual original Task/current active Run and their original journals/profile/effects byte-for-byte. Add one schema-valid synthetic nonhead Run belonging to that same original Task, using full original Run shape and explicit new id/time fields recorded in mutation spec. Its chronology is a synthetic test input; original task membership comes from original immutable commands. Existing settled current Run acts as later/head Run, so no need to rewrite original Task or original Run.
nonhead_run_controls.positive: New synthetic nonhead Run terminal/children_stopped/queue_empty/runtime_settled_at valid, matching schema-valid RUN_STATE projection and no unresolved effect; original current Run remains settled.
nonhead_run_controls.negative_unknown: Same synthetic terminal nonhead Run/projection as positive; append new synthetic effect key through effectAppend with UNKNOWN. Original effect rows and original ledger untouched. This models unresolved nonhead fact, not an actual provider dispatch.
nonhead_run_controls.negative_running: Same full synthetic nonhead Run but status RUNNING with its schema-valid corresponding RUN_STATE projection. No new runtime process. Original current head unchanged.
nonhead_run_controls.expected: Both negatives must typed SESSION_BUSY with earlier session run is not settled; positive COMPLETED. Record current-head clientTurnSettled=true as read-only precondition, exact nonhead facts and original membership. No custom validator replacement or production branch change.
